map.根据容量、电压与放电深度估算可用电量。: Estimate usable energy from capacity, voltage and depth of discharge.
map.E = 容量(Ah) × 电压(V) / 1000 × 放电深度: E = capacity (Ah) × voltage (V) / 1000 × depth of discharge
map.DoD 越高可用容量越大但伤寿命。: A higher DoD gives more usable capacity but shortens battery life.
map.与日用电曲线，估算可支撑时长。: and the daily electricity curve to estimate the supported duration.
map.离网配置：对光伏+储能录入参数，判断能否覆盖夜间负荷。: Off-grid sizing: enter PV + storage parameters to judge whether the night-time load can be covered.
map.教学演示：演示容量(kWh)=功率(kW)×时长(h)的关系。: Teaching demo: show the relation capacity (kWh) = power (kW) × duration (h).
map.示例：10 kWh 电池、平均负载 1 kW，可供电约 10 h（不计损耗）；实: Example: a 10 kWh battery with a 1 kW average load supplies about 10 h (ignoring losses); in practice the depth of discharge limits it to about 8–9 h.
map.容量和功率区别？: What is the difference between capacity and power?
map.kWh 是能量（能存多少），kW 是功率（能放多快）；同一电池大功率放电时长短。: kWh is energy (how much can be stored) while kW is power (how fast it can be delivered); the same battery lasts a shorter time at high power. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.放电深度影响？: How does depth of discharge matter?
map.锂电池常限 DoD 80–90%，可用容量低于标称，配置时按可用能量算。结果按公: Lithium batteries are usually limited to 80–90% DoD, so usable capacity is below the nominal value and sizing should be based on usable energy. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.充放电有 85–95% 往返效率，长时储能需计入损耗。结果按公开标准与环境因子估: Charging and discharging have an 85–95% round-trip efficiency, and long-duration storage must include those losses. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
